mechanism_narrative: Lower federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) compress equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in lower risk-free rates.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, with p-value > 0.05 for positive returns in t-test against baseline.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate falls below 0.25%, it signals aggressive monetary easing that boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.25, with p-value > 0.05 for positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPIAUCSL exceeds 230 and FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, delayed monetary response to inflation leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods meeting CPIAUCSL > 230 and FEDFUNDS < 0.5, with p-value > 0.05 for positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.5%), the Federal Reserve maintains accommodative policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 5.5, with p-value > 0.05 for positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) signal strengthening consumer sector and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST > 1000, with p-value > 0.05 for positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: Higher industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices sustained growth.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO > 105, with p-value > 0.05 for positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1000, it signals strong consumer demand and economic activity, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST > 1000, with p-value > 0.05 for positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1000 and residential sales (RSAFS) exceed 400,000, it indicates robust housing market and consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods meeting HOUST > 1000 and RSAFS > 400000, with p-value > 0.05 for positive returns.
